_comment: pydyn's scope: Dynare features pydyn has decided not to implement (for now). A test listed here that pydyn REFUSES is `excluded` in the comparison report (feature and reason shown); one pydyn runs is compared normally and flagged. Format and rules: docs/ACCEPTANCE.md, rule 6. To park another feature add an entry {feature, reason, ids (test ids or fnmatch patterns such as 'method_of_moments/*'), expect (optional regex of the refusal message)}. Per-port: another port keeps its own file.

entries.feature: parameter derivatives of the order-2/3 solution and the pruned state space (identification at order > 1, get_perturbation_params_derivs at order > 1)
entries.reason: parked by decision: low priority, identification at order 1 covers the usual use

entries.feature: semi-structural model tools: equation-by-equation estimation (dyn_ols, sur, pooled_ols, pooled_fgls, olsgibbs, surgibbs), cherrypick and the equation.* package, which share Dynare's JSON equation parser (matlab/ols, about 1,800 lines, plus cherrypick.m, 525 lines) (a test counts here also when it first needs a dseries csv reader or the dseries firstdate method, since the equation tools would follow)
entries.reason: for semi-structural models: parked by decision, not used in the DSGE workflow pydyn targets

entries.feature: method of moments estimation (Dynare's method_of_moments toolbox: method_of_moments command with matched_moments and matched_irfs blocks; GMM, SMM, IRF matching; estimated_params blocks for it)
global sensitivity analysis (Dynare's gsa toolbox: dynare_sensitivity command, Morris screening, Monte Carlo filtering, Saltelli/stability mapping)
prior/posterior calibration (irf_calibration and moment_calibration blocks, Monte Carlo filtering of prior draws against IRF/moment restrictions, part of the gsa toolbox)
Markov-switching SBVAR and DSGE (ms-sbvar toolbox: svar_identification, ms_estimation, ms_simulation, ms_compute_mdd, ms_irf, ms_forecast, ms_variance_decomposition; markov_switching/ms-dsge)
Bayesian VAR a la Sims (bvar toolbox: bvar_density, bvar_forecast; bvar_and_dsge is blocked first by its data-file script, then by these commands)
recursive estimation and rolling-window forecasts (estimation with vector-valued nobs or first_obs: one estimation per sample end)
partial information solution (stoch_simul(partial_information) and the partial-information dr: Dynare's PCL / dr1_PI solver)
skewed shocks and the skewed Kalman filter (shocks block skewness, set_shock_skew_value, estimated_params skew_exo, skew-normal likelihood in estimation)
reporting package (Dynare's report class: r = report(...); addPage, addGraph, addTable, addSeries, write, compile; LaTeX output)
balanced growth path package (bgp.write(M_) and the generated bgpfun, +bgp in matlab/)
contribution plots of an equation (plot_contributions statement, equation package: decomposition of an equation into the contributions of its right-hand side)
entries.expect: cannot parse: unexpected 'ffr'|this kind of index|plot_contributions
